audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the terrain rule that decides this lane, and level 1 was rated 'Skill' while whys[0] said Galio wins it.
audit.why: Prophet of an Elder God spawns tentacles only on nearby impassable terrain, so where Illaoi stands sets how much damage she has. Galio's level 1 is genuinely stronger (Colossal Smash passive auto + 825-range Winds of War).
audit.corrected: Level 1 flipped to Galio on both layers with the Colossal Smash wind-up tell written in; levels 4-5 and 6 flipped to Illaoi to match the packet chart, with the wall-hugging rule stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-6 text called Leap of Faith a '1v3 button' with no numbers and no mention of what it actually does to Galio.
audit.why: Leap of Faith is 120/95/70s, grounds, and spawns one tentacle per champion hit. Grounding is what beats Galio's only dash.
audit.corrected: Level-6 phase why and whys[4] now state the grounding of Justice Punch and the 120s rank-1 cost of a wasted ultimate.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] said 'W Justice Punch' — wrong slot. Justice Punch is Galio's E; his W is Shield of Durand, the taunt. The decisive interaction (R grounding his dash) was never stated.
audit.why: Kit file: Galio E = dash + knockup, 11/10/9/8/7s; W = taunt/shield, 18-14s. Illaoi R carries the grounding flag, which shuts off dashes, so an ulting Illaoi traps Galio inside her tentacle field.
audit.corrected: Slot corrected, and the grounding interaction plus real cooldowns (Justice Punch 11s rank 1, Harsh Lesson flat 4s, Test of Spirit 16s) written into the cooldown block, do's, key-interaction report and phases.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing cues; the cooldown block had no numbers at all.
audit.why: Concrete windows are what make the advice actionable.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with rank-1 numbers for all four relevant abilities.

audit.why: Missing-interactions file flags it: Galio's combo opens with the charged auto, so the wind-up — not the ability cast — is the cue to step back.

edits.before: Plant tentacles before contesting anything. Identify how Galio contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Galio owns level 1: Colossal Smash (P) charges his auto for bonus AoE — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Justice Punch's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Yours: hug a wall so Prophet plants tentacles, then trade every time Justice Punch (E) is on its 9-8s cooldown and bank the leads.

edits.before: Leap of Faith inside your tentacle field is a 1v3 button. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Galio's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Leap of Faith grounds Justice Punch and spawns a tentacle per champion hit — 120s at rank 1, so spend it only on a real kill window.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Justice Punch (E): 11s at rank 1, his only dash — once spent he cannot leave your tentacles for 11 seconds. - Harsh Lesson (W): flat 4s, so leap freely. - Test of Spirit (E): 16s — never spend it on chip. - Leap of Faith: 120s, kill windows only.

edits.before: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Justice Punch (E) is his only dash, 11s at rank 1 — bait it, then commit for the whole window.

edits.before: Track Galio's Justice Punch: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. When it is down — Land E, slam the spirit.
edits.after: Justice Punch (E) is a dash — Leap of Faith grounds him, so ulting mid-fight locks him in your tentacles. His taunt never stops them.

edits.before: Galio wins level 1 — his Q poke and passive magic shield beat your pre-W trades.
edits.after: Galio wins level 1 — Winds of War (Q) pokes at 825 range while you have no leap yet.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you keep control — his Q sustain can't match your tentacle DPS.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are yours — fight by a wall so tentacles spawn; Q won't match them.

edits.before: Level 6 R tentacle wall plus E-Spirit beats his non-duel ultimate.
edits.after: Level 6: R grounds Justice Punch, and his R is no duel button.

edits.before: W Justice Punch to interrupt your W engage
edits.after: Justice Punch (E) to knock up your W leap

notes: Slot error corrected: Justice Punch is Galio's E, not his W (his W is Shield of Durand, the taunt). The decisive fact this page lacked: Leap of Faith grounds, and Justice Punch is Galio's only dash, so ulting after he spends it means he cannot leave the tentacle field. Second: Illaoi's tentacles spawn only on impassable terrain — standing mid-lane instead of against a wall halves her damage.
